definitions.gloss: Awa Odori, the Tokushima dance festival
definitions.explanation: The Bon dance festival of Tokushima city on Shikoku, once the province of Awa, held August 12–15. Groups of dancers parade through the streets to shamisen, drums, flutes, and bells in a lively two-beat rhythm; also the dance itself.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- ⟦{踊|おど}る→踊る：01250_odoru⟧⟦{阿呆|あほう}→阿呆：21852_ahou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧⟦{阿呆|あほう}→阿呆：21852_ahou⟧、⟦{同|おな}じ→同じ：02857_onaji⟧⟦{阿呆|あほう}→阿呆：21852_ahou⟧なら⟦{踊|おど}らな→踊る：01250_odoru⟧⟦{損|そん}→損：03325_son⟧⟦{損|そん}→損：03325_son⟧: "The dancers are fools and the watchers are fools; if we're all fools, we may as well dance!" — the festival's famous chant

- {男踊|おとこおど}り / {女踊|おんなおど}り: the men's bold, crouching style / the women's graceful style in straw hats

CULTURAL NOTE:
Awa Odori events are also held elsewhere, most famously in Tokyo's {高円寺|こうえんじ} each August.
